agentUpdateInstructions: Preserve owner customizations, applied migration bytes and matching source/D1/R2/private-settings backups. Mango 0.4.0 uses pinned @runeditrun/rer 0.2.76, Node 22.20.0 and pnpm 10.12.4. Stop dev and writers before upgrading. Back up first, then git pull --ff-only (or merge/reapply customizations deliberately), rer install, and apply migrations 0077_signup_refusal_hours through 0080_portability_import_leases in filename order (rer setup locally; rer deploy --environment NAME hosted). Earlier migration files are unchanged; never rename or renumber a migration. Run rer build before a fresh export. Base portability copies are recorded at rer-v0.2.76 (base-copies.json, verify-base drift 0); import.mjs, journal.mjs, copies.mjs and backfills.mjs are Mango adaptations recorded in edition.json. backfills.mjs keeps a write that reads a table the applied history created and dropped out of restore replays; once Base ships that rule, readopt its verbatim file. The local restore door replays this checkout's migrations, resolves Platform rer_migrations entries by SHA-256 with core- aliases, and on a Platform-migrated database skips Wrangler after checking every migration file is applied; keep that preflight. Stripe connections and role grants belong to the destination and are not restored from an archive. Keep confirmed-only resubscription, consent and opt-out precedence, suppression, exact-revision approval and uncertain-handoff fences intact. Local rer dev admits the owner through the private RER_OPEN entry; never add a captured-mail inbox or outbox. Use affected public-flow checks and CI Verify; local proof is not hosted acceptance. Refresh source:lock and integration declarations for intentional source changes. Agent-door adoption adds /mcp and /agents. Apply migrations 0104 through 0107 after retaining main’s applied 0103 contact-property migration. Existing private integration reads and sends now require an explicit company policy as well as their native revision and segment authority. Preserve durable Business IDs, sponsor/scopes/consent custody and unknown provider outcomes. Complete contract alignment and the matching CLI conformance before accepting this adoption; runtime and CLI pins are separate. An agent cannot supply a person's manual single-opt-in attestation; absent a native consent proof that case refuses. Confirmed opt-in still requires the recipient's own confirmation.
publicReleaseNotes: Mango 0.4.0 (21 October 2026) adds an activity log for the Owner and Admins with filters and CSV export, keeps a removed operator's name on their work, names every blocked link and image in review and lets a Manager allow an unlisted host there, shows the SMS opt-out wording in review, and lists commerce and dormancy exclusions. It also adds an optional Stripe connection and SendGrid domain setup, both partial. A backup from an earlier Mango, including the build Run Edit Run Managed lists, now restores with rer import, also into a database Run Edit Run Platform migrated. Back up first: four additive migrations (0077-0080) apply in filename order and a 0.3.0 install keeps all its data. It pins rer 0.2.76 and adapts one Base restore rule until Base ships it. Hosted backup and restore are not built in, and Delivered, bounce and complaint reports need a SendGrid signed Event Webhook. Product screenshot: .github/assets/release/mango-0.4.0-activity-1440.png
